checks.name: Authenticated status reports no-model readiness and zero execution capacity
Generation without a model returns structured HTTP 503
Default auto concurrency resolves to one active CPU request

concurrency.reason: CPU execution generates one reply at a time; additional requests queue

checks.name: Full generation queue returns HTTP 429 with queue_full and Retry-After
Malformed chat is rejected before generation admission while the queue is full
Status remains responsive during real CPU decoding and a full queue
FIFO is observable over HTTP: second queued generation starts before the third
Queued disconnect cancels once, never reaches generation, and capacity recovers
Waiting deadline returns HTTP 503 queue_timeout without executing the expired request
Timeout and active cancellation release capacity; subsequent real inference returns AAAA

synchronization: Observed live active/queued/status counters and actual HTTP responses; no product test-delay hooks
scope: CPU HTTP admission, queue bounds, FIFO, timeout and cancellation; not model quality or GPU throughput

fixture.description: Untrained F32 CPU Qwen3MoE; repeated real nonzero fixture layers, deterministic A output
